NDT Training and Certification in Philippines — Philippines

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in Philippines: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The Philippines inspection market

The Philippines' NDT market is centred on Petron Bataan Refinery, the Pilipinas Shell Tabangao depot, Hanjin Subic shipyard legacy ops (now Cerberus / Agile), Petron Limay, Aboitiz Power generation fleet, and an expanding semiconductor manufacturing base. Maritime, refining and power-gen drive NDT demand.

Certifications most in demand in Philippines

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: ISO 9712. Also frequently requested: PCN, CSWIP.

Recommended certification pathway

Petron and Pilipinas Shell follow ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Shipyard work uses ABS / Lloyd's Register class protocols. PCN/CSWIP widely accepted on international fabrication contracts.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
